# Contiguous allocation: deleting files leaves holes (external
# fragmentation); a file larger than the largest hole cannot be stored
# even though there is enough free space in total, until `compact` packs
# the used blocks together.
set_alloc contiguous
create /a.bin --size 8KB
create /b.bin --size 12KB
create /c.bin --size 8KB
create /d.bin --size 16KB
create /e.bin --size 8KB
rm /b.bin
rm /d.bin
fs_status --details
create /big.bin --size 20KB
compact
create /big.bin --size 20KB
fs_status
